name: veriphy
description: An extensible verification framework with agents in the loop. Steps are pinned and recorded, levels carry a trust class, and workflows decide the next step from the records. Packs bring each field: Lean and mathematics (the prove, certify and research skills, the veriphy certify tactic, kernel-checked certificates with SageMath as an untrusted oracle), and reproduction of published analyses (the reproduce skill), over a claim graph checked by the Lean checker oo-horn.
